steps.what: Serve as a confidential point of contact for employees
Help employees communicate with management or seek clarification
Hear issues or dilemmas and report irregularities only in person

tasks.design: The manager serves as a confidential point of contact for employees to communicate with management, seek clarification on issues or dilemmas, or report irregularities. The conversation stays at full effort. A report is not routed by a rule. Employees are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager took the conversation in person.
tasks.still_hard: What to tell management, and what to keep confidential, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not pass on a report the employee did not agree to share.
tasks.altitude: The confidential conversation stays at full effort.

evidence.claim: A confidential employee conversation stays with the manager.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every confidential conversation is still held by the manager. High: the same conversation remains, with no report routed by a rule. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify policies are documented and communicated

steps.what: List policies and procedures with a blank documented flag
Verify regulatory policies were implemented and communicated

tasks.design: The manager verifies that regulatory policies and procedures have been documented, implemented, and communicated. {DOCS} only lists stored rows whose documented flag is blank. A blank flag stays blank and is not treated as done. The manager still verifies each policy, at full effort. The list does not decide that a policy is adequate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager checked the register and then read the policies.
tasks.enabler_now: Blank flags can be listed. The verification stays the manager's.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a policy is really in place stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a row that treats a blank flag as done.
tasks.altitude: The register scan is clerical. Verification of each policy stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear which policies the manager has not yet verified

evidence.claim: A blank documented flag can be listed. Verifying that a policy is implemented and communicated stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with the policy register and ends when the manager has verified, or stops.
A policy row has identifier, documented flag, implemented flag, and communicated flag, entered by the manager. A blank flag is left blank and is not stored as done.
The list does not mark a policy adequate. Employees are not scored.
unknowns: Which policies the manager must verify this period.
research_questions: How often was a flag blank?

already_counted.description: Verifying the policies is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a flag before the manager relies on the list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: flags are often blank, so the manager still opens the policies one by one. High: flags are filled, the blanks are listed, and the manager still verifies each policy. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Draft written policies and procedures related to compliance activities
Review whether to disseminate the accepted policies

tasks.design: The manager disseminates written policies and procedures related to compliance activities. The manager still writes the policy, at full effort. {EMAIL} sends only the version the manager has accepted. A blank section stays blank and stops the send. The send does not change the policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager wrote the policy and sent it.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted policy text can be sent. Writing it stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: What the policy says stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not send a section they left blank.
tasks.altitude: The policy is sent only after the manager accepts that version.

reach.task: Receive only a policy the manager accepted

evidence.claim: An accepted policy text can be sent. Writing the policy stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a policy the manager is writing and ends when the accepted version is sent, or the manager stops.
A draft has title and body, written by the manager. A blank body is left blank and is not invented.
The send uses the version accepted in the review. It does not edit the text.
unknowns: Which audiences must receive which policy.
research_questions: How often did a blank section stop the send?

already_counted.description: Writing the policy is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct the text before the policy is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: sections are often still blank, so the manager still writes the policy. High: the text is complete, the manager reviews it, and only the accepted policy is sent. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble stored figures for compliance operations
Prepare management reports regarding compliance progress
Review the management report before it is filed

tasks.design: The manager prepares management reports regarding compliance operations and progress. {SPREADSHEET} only assembles stored figures. A blank figure stays blank and is not zero. The manager still writes the report, at full effort. {DOCS} files only the report the manager has accepted. Filing does not send it to an agency.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager wrote the report from the figures.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored figures can be tabulated. The narrative stays the manager's.
tasks.still_hard: What the progress means stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager refuses a report that fills a blank figure.
tasks.altitude: The report is filed only after the manager accepts that version.

reach.task: Read only a report the manager accepted

evidence.claim: Stored operations figures can be tabulated. Writing the management report stays manual, and only an accepted version is filed.

assumptions: The work starts with the period and ends when the accepted report is filed, or the manager stops.
An operations line has name and amount, entered by the manager. A blank amount is left blank and is not treated as zero.
The file uses the report accepted in the review. It is not sent to an agency from this step.
research_questions: How often did a blank figure stop the draft?

already_counted.description: Writing the report is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a figure before the report is accepted.

approvals.approved_version: management report the compliance manager accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: figures are often blank, so the manager still writes the report from notes. High: figures are complete, the manager writes and reviews, and only the accepted report is filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
